h1: Custom Paper Door Hangers for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Paper Door Hangers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom paper door hangers for your next campaign. Perfect for bulk orders with fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Paper door hangers offer a lightweight, cost-effective way to deliver your message directly to customers. Unlike plastic or laminated alternatives, paper door hangers are easy to write on, recyclable, and ideal for short-term promotions, restaurant menus, or event reminders. With a smooth surface that takes printing beautifully, you can showcase bold colors and detailed graphics. The Door Hanger Superseal and Door Hanger Oval Paper Card are popular options that combine durability with a classic paper feel.
heroAltText: Stack of custom paper door hangers with printed message and keyhole cutout
